changeSet.sql:
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
drop table if exists #existingRuleResults create table #existingRuleResults (RuleUid uniqueidentifier,Uid uniqueidentifier, EffectiveDate date, RunDate date, RowsPassed int, RowsFailed int, CreatedOn date, CreatedBy int, UpdatedOn date, UpdatedBy int)
insert into #existingRuleResults (RuleUid, uid, EffectiveDate, RunDate, RowsPassed, RowsFailed, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, UpdatedOn, UpdatedBy) select A.uid as RuleUid, newid() as Uid, RR.EffectiveDate, RR.RunDate, RowsPassed, RowsFailed, RR.CreatedOn, RR.CreatedBy, RR.CreatedOn, Rr.CreatedBy from RuleResult RR inner join RuleImplementation RI on RI.ID = RR.RuleImplementationID inner join [Rule] R on R.ID = RI.RuleID inner join [RuleType] RT on R.RuleTypeID = RT.ID inner join Asset A on A.Object = 'Rule' and ObjectId = R.ID where RowsPassed != 0 or RowsFailed != 0
INSERT INTO AssetResult ([Uid] ,[EffectiveDate] ,[RunDate] ,[PassCount] ,[FailCount] ,[CreatedOn] ,[CreatedBy] ,[UpdatedOn] ,[UpdatedBy]) select uid, EffectiveDate,RunDate, RowsPassed, RowsFailed, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, CreatedBy from #existingRuleResults
INSERT INTO [dbo].[AssetResultEdge] ($from_id,$to_id,[Class]) select AN.$node_Id, AR.$node_Id, 1 from #existingRuleResults ERR inner join graph.AssetNode AN on AN.Uid = ERR.[RuleUid] inner join dbo.AssetResult AR on AR.Uid = ERR.[Uid]
COMMIT END TRY BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN
DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE() DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY() DECLARE @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()
RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState); END CATCH
